faq_items.question: What does Chikku Robotics do?
faq_items.answer: We build intelligent robots for a smarter future! 🤖 From service bots and collaborative arms to autonomous vehicles and drones — all powered by our own AI brain.

faq_items.question: What does the name Chikku mean?
faq_items.answer: It's named after the sweet sapodilla fruit loved across Asia! 🍈 Just like the fruit, our robots are friendly, human-centered, and naturally delightful.

faq_items.question: What types of robots do you make?
faq_items.answer: We make service robots, collaborative arms, autonomous mobile vehicles, and drone systems! 🤖 Plus we build our own sensors and electronics in-house too.

faq_items.question: What AI technologies do you use?
faq_items.answer: Our Chikku Brain runs deep learning, computer vision, NLP, and generative AI — all on-device! 🧠 That means ultra-fast responses, total privacy, and offline smarts.

faq_items.question: Are your robots safe to work alongside humans?
faq_items.answer: Absolutely, safety is our top priority! 🛡️ Our robots have smart collision detection, 360° LiDAR zones, and meet the strictest international safety standards. You're in good hands!

faq_items.question: How much does a Chikku robot cost?
faq_items.answer: Prices vary by model and scale, but we also offer Robot-as-a-Service subscriptions with zero upfront costs! 💰 Reach out to our sales team for a personalized quote.

faq_items.question: What is Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS)?
faq_items.answer: It's a monthly subscription instead of buying the robot outright! 📦 Covers hardware, software, maintenance, and upgrades — no big investment, just predictable monthly fees.

faq_items.question: How long does deployment take?
faq_items.answer: Pretty fast! 🚀 Service robots take one to two weeks, collaborative robots about two to four weeks per cell. We handle the whole setup plus staff training.

faq_items.question: Where are you located?
faq_items.answer: Our HQ is in India, with R&D labs in Vietnam and Tamil Nadu! 🌏 We serve customers all around the globe through our sales team and partner network.

faq_items.question: Do you provide training?
faq_items.answer: Sure thing! 🎓 We offer hands-on training for operators, programmers, and fleet admins — from two to five days, on-site or at our training centers.

faq_items.question: What industries do you serve?
faq_items.answer: Manufacturing, healthcare, warehousing, smart cities, agriculture, hospitality, retail — you name it! 🌍 Our robots work hard in over twenty countries across all these sectors.

faq_items.question: How do I get started with Chikku Robotics?
faq_items.answer: Easy peasy! 🎉 Book a free Automation Readiness Assessment — we'll check out your operations and build a custom robot roadmap just for you.

faq_items.question: Do you offer custom robot development?
faq_items.answer: Yes, for unique needs beyond our standard lineup! 🔧 We do full-cycle custom development from concept to production, made faster with our modular platform approach.

faq_items.question: How do your robots handle different languages?
faq_items.answer: Our bots speak over thirty languages naturally! 🌐 English, Mandarin, Japanese, Hindi, Vietnamese — you name it. Real-time translation makes conversations seamless.

faq_items.question: What is your warranty and support policy?
faq_items.answer: All robots come with a one-year warranty! 🛠️ We've got extended plans with fast response times and spare parts depots worldwide for quick fixes.

faq_items.question: What are your featured products?
faq_items.answer: We've got three stars! ⭐ The Voice AI Kiosk chats with customers, S-Robot cleans solar panels autonomously, and WatchGuard6S guards solar farms 24/7 with AI smarts.

faq_items.question: What products does Chikku Robotics currently offer?
faq_items.answer: Our big three: Voice AI Kiosk for customer interaction, S-Robot for solar cleaning, and WatchGuard6S for security! 🎯 Plus service robots, cobots, drones, and custom AI.

faq_items.question: Tell me about your robotics products
faq_items.answer: The Voice AI Kiosk charms customers in retail, S-Robot keeps solar panels sparkling clean, and WatchGuard6S never sleeps guarding solar farms! 🤖 We also build cobots, drones, and more.
